message: The other day, I found myself organizing my pantry for what I like to call "just in case" scenarios. I had enough canned beans and soup to feed a small army, or at least my family during a snowstorm. My daughter rolled her eyes, but hey, when the weather gets dicey, I like to be the gloriously over-prepared person. What’s your take on being ready for anything? Do you have a secret stash for emergencies?
